taxonomic_note: Accepted and Texas-native at state scale. Current project evidence locks only Travis as a wild target-zone locality.
look_here_first: Start with the perennial clump and leaves: mostly basal/lower lanceolate leaves, long nearly leafless peduncles, and large all-yellow heads.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Travis is retained from wild Reimers Ranch/Austin-area evidence. Williamson is outside the target zone; Hays and Bexar records in the current review are horticultural recommendations and are excluded.

approval_exception.reason: Learner inclusion is independent from native-range certification.

best_field_traits: basal and lower lanceolate to oblanceolate leaves
outer phyllaries narrow; inner phyllaries broader and united near base
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Unlike annual C. wrightii, C. lanceolata is clump-forming and perennial with broader lanceolate lower leaves and long nearly leafless stalks.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Perennial clump + broad lanceolate basal leaves + long nearly leafless peduncles; do not use yellow flower color alone.
